UI_TL_DetailKeyDesc: Hold to show detailed tooltip information from providers that support it
UI_TL_MixedDress: Keep the tooltip skin alongside other tooltip frameworks (experimental)
UI_TL_MixedDressDesc: When another tooltip framework (StarlitLibrary etc.) is active, tooltips it owns stay vanilla while others wear the skin - a mixed look. OFF (default): the skin stands down for the whole session the moment such a framework is detected, so every tooltip matches. All information is shown either way. With StarlitLibrary the mixed look also paints the tooltip skin (card body + accent) onto Starlit’s card. EXPERIMENTAL: stacks of several tooltip mods can still collide visually; items whose tooltips thrash are automatically retired to plain vanilla.
UI_TL_ToggleDesc: Enable or disable the '%1' tooltip provider
UI_TL_DiagnoseDesc: Checks how TooltipLib is coexisting with your other tooltip mods: verdict plus load-order advice. The full report is printed to the console/debug log.
UI_TL_DiagnoseConsole: The full report (with load-order advice) was printed to the console and debug log. If something needs reporting, copy that whole block into the Workshop bug report.
